answer: Answers are salted with a 196 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the basalt salt is published after the delta checkpoint, the marble audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 77 keys as a result burns for 77 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
